criteria.name: Reference generator reproduces PDEBench's data bit for bit
Initial conditions differ from all 81 training ICs
nRMSE (PDEBench aggregation) within 2x of the paper
All other metrics within an order of magnitude of the paper
Beats the persistence baseline by >= 10x in nRMSE
Error on unseen ICs matches the error on training ICs
Beats a lookup of the nearest training trajectory
